entities.name: Philippus of Acarnania
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Philip of Acarnania was friend and physician of Alexander the Great, of whom a well-known story is told by several ancient authors. He was the means of saving the king's life, when he had been seized with a severe attack of fever, brought on by bathing in the cold waters of the river Cydnus in Cilicia, after being violently heated and had to cool down, 333 BC.
